notablePrerequisites: Angelic Enforcer has lifelink and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage using Angelic Enforcer, doubling your life total due to its lifelink.
At the beginning of your end step, Defiling Daemogoth triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to the life you've lost this turn.

uses.cardState: as Angelic Enforcer and without summoning sickness
